entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who has ascended to an archangel, arriving on Tarkir to ask how it has kept dragonstorms at bay; she helps fight a wild dragon.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A former planeswalker, now waymaster of the Jeskai, whose spark guttered out; she fears her ritual destabilized Tarkir but ends by deciding to help Elspeth.

entities.name: Taigam
entities.description: An older Jeskai monk, once Narset's peer at the Dragon's Eye Sanctuary, who led a coup against Ojutai and now urges Narset to send Elspeth away.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker, a friend of Narset and Elspeth, who came to Tarkir and only ever wanted peace.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A moonfolk planeswalker, Narset's friend, who loved to learn every story; she is spoken of as one who would have been glad of the meeting.

entities.name: Nissa
entities.description: A planeswalker brought back along with Ajani at great cost.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: An elder dragon whose presence catalyzed the original dragonstorms and whose departure Narset believes caused them to grow stronger.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon, described as dead.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: The late Jeskai dragonlord whom Narset loved and Taigam stayed loyal to before leading a coup against him.

entities.name: Wild dragon
entities.description: A huge ice-breathing wild dragon that gores its way through the hull of Storm Crane into the school and is driven off after Elspeth cuts its mouth.

entities.name: Storm Crane
entities.description: The Jeskai's flying monastery, a ruined temple ship with a school in its belly, famous for its healers.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: A plane where the dragonstorms have become more potent and reshape the land.

entities.name: Dragon's Eye Sanctuary
entities.description: The place where Narset and Taigam advanced in rank under Ojutai.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir led by the waymaster, whose monks and skyriders defend Storm Crane.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: A clan whose contacts report parts of the steppes growing scales.

entities.name: Dragonstorms
entities.description: Storms on Tarkir that have grown more potent, producing larger and hungrier dragons and reshaping land.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes, which Narset can no longer walk since her spark guttered out.

entities.name: Spirit dragons
entities.description: Dragons summoned by Narset's ritual during the Tarkir rebellion.

events.summary: Elspeth arrives on the Jeskai skyship Storm Crane and a small child asks if she is a dragon, frightening her mother.
events.quote: And you have four other limbs

events.summary: Narset greets Elspeth, who explains that dragonstorms have begun appearing across the Multiverse and asks how Tarkir kept them at bay.
events.quote: Dragonstorms have begun appearing throughout the Multiverse.

events.summary: Narset reflects on Ajani, Tamiyo and her lost spark, and Elspeth recalls the cost of bringing Ajani and Nissa back.
events.quote: It cost everything to bring him and Nissa back.

events.summary: Narset shows a map of how Tarkir's dragonstorms have become more potent, with reports of scales growing on the steppes and new, hungrier dragons.
events.quote: So much so, they've begun to reshape Tarkir itself,

events.summary: Narset theorizes that Ugin's departure unleashed the stronger storms, since he served as a metaphysical ballast.
events.quote: It has something to do with Ugin's departure, I am sure of it.

events.summary: Narset refuses to modify the ritual and confesses that it may have destabilized Tarkir's balance and caused a chain reaction.
events.quote: it may have destabilized the delicate balance in Tarkir, resulting in a chain reaction.

events.summary: Bells ring and Narset announces that a wild dragon is inside the school.
events.quote: There's a wild dragon inside the school !

events.summary: Narset and Elspeth find the dragon, which has gored through the hull and is closing on six trapped youths behind a girl's barrier.
events.quote: it had gored its way up through the ship's hull, chewed its way through wood and metal.

events.summary: Elspeth dives into the dragon's mouth and drives her sword into its skull as monks rescue the children.
events.quote: Elspeth dove headfirst into the open maw, sword held out like a beacon.

events.summary: The wounded dragon flees to the deck and then off the ship while skyriders engage it.
events.quote: It began to writhe back, struggling to escape its attackers

events.summary: Elspeth says she will respect Narset's decision, and Narset promises one in the morning.
events.quote: I'll give you my decision in the morning.

events.summary: After the damage count, Narset gives Elspeth a guest room and Elspeth says Ajani spoke kindly of her.
events.quote: Ajani said very kind things about you.

events.summary: Taigam warns that Elspeth is an omen and that her arrival may have provoked the attack, and urges Narset to send her away.
events.quote: Send her away, Narset. As far away from the Jeskai as it is possible,

events.summary: Narset tells Elspeth the Jeskai cannot help, then reveals she will go herself.

relations.quote: I am Narset, waymaster of the Jeskai.

relations.note: shared friends; they fight the dragon together
relations.quote: We've shared many friends in common.
She thought of Tamiyo and her story circle

relations.note: he led a coup against his old dragonlord
relations.quote: Certainly, he would not have led a coup against him.

relations.note: a monk of the Jeskai whose waymaster she is

relations.quote: Whatever had happened wasn't enough to deter the Jeskai from making use of the ruins.

relations.note: his presence catalyzed the original storms
relations.quote: His presence catalyzed, if not outright created, the original storms.
